content.title: {{SILENT}} SIGNALS YOUR BODY SENDS BEFORE A DEFICIENCY GETS SERIOUS
facts: **Iodine** – Unexplained weight gain, fatigue, puffy face, and feeling cold when others don't.
**Vitamin K** – Bruising easily, cuts that take forever to stop bleeding, and bleeding gums.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, vision problems, and numbness or tingling in the limbs.
**Folate** – Constant tiredness, pale skin, mouth sores, and brain fog that won't lift.
**Vitamin A** – Dry eyes, trouble seeing in low light, and rough, bumpy patches on the skin.
**Calcium** – Brittle nails, muscle cramps, and numbness or tingling around the mouth and fingers.
**Omega-3** – Dry, flaky skin, stiff joints in the morning, and trouble focusing.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these deficiency signs are easy to brush off, but your body is usually being very specific. Low iodine slows down your thyroid, which is the gland that controls how fast your cells burn energy, so everything from your metabolism to your body temperature can drop. Not enough vitamin K means your body can't produce the proteins needed for normal blood clotting, which is exactly why small cuts or bumps bruise more than they should. And low folate affects how your body makes new red blood cells, so you end up with fewer oxygen carriers in your blood, which shows up as that heavy, can't-shake-it tiredness. Everyone's body is different, so if a few of these sound familiar, it's worth getting your levels checked rather than guessing.

At @smarthealthfix we cover nutrition, common symptoms, organ health, and the small daily habits that tie it all together. Our mission is to help you notice what your body is telling you early, instead of waiting until small signals turn into bigger problems.
